financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales under Amended ATM Facility with Cantor, Oct 1 - Nov 3, 2023
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: During the period October 1, 2023 through and inclusive of November 3, 2023, we issued 2,454,618 shares of our common stock for net proceeds of $80.3 million under the Amended ATM Facility.
